sources.title: Widget2Code - djanghao.github.io
sources.snippet: We present qualitative comparisons between our method (Widget2Code) and baseline approaches across diverse widget designs. Each example shows the input widget alongside outputs from generalized MLLMs (Gemini-2.5-Pro, GPT-4o, Qwen3-VL), specialized UI2Code models (ScreenCoder, UI-UG), and our method.

sources.title: From Visual Widgets to UI Code: Efficient Tool-Grounded Generation
sources.snippet: We evaluate six checkpoints from the Qwen3-VL [4], Qwen3.5 [25], and Qwen3.6 [26] families, ranging from 4 $4$ B to 32 $32$ B parameters. Each model is adapted with LoRA [18] while keeping the vision encoder frozen.
